content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

At its core, this approach focuses on establishing a direct connection between creators and their customers through a decentralized payment system. By utilizing cryptocurrency for transactions, you eliminate the need for third-party platforms that often impose high fees and restrictions. For example, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while using NOWPayments allows you to retain 99.5% of your revenue. This matters because it empowers creators to maximize their earnings and maintain full control over their digital products.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of several components that work in harmony to facilitate seamless sales. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the hosting solution, enabling you to showcase your Notion templates. On the backend, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manages the transaction logic, while order storage is handled by Supabase or Google Sheets. Lastly, NOWPayments enables automatic crypto payment processing, with instant product delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This infrastructure ensures a smooth experience for both creators and customers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is specifically designed for digital creators in regions such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela, where traditional payment processors may not be accessible. If you're selling ebooks, courses, or templates, this solution allows you to bypass the limitations of conventional platforms. It's built for those who want to control their digital commerce without being subjected to high fees or restrictions. By adopting this infrastructure, you can sell your products directly to customers, keeping more of your earnings.
Retain 99.5% of your earnings with low transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this infrastructure include hosting platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend solutions such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and payment processing through NOWPayments. In addition, tools like Supabase or Google Sheets are essential for managing orders and customer data. Together, these components create a cohesive system that ensures your digital products are delivered instantly and securely, with full ownership and control over your data.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your Notion templates for crypto, first set up your hosting using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle transactions. Load your products into Supabase or Google Sheets for order management, and integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Ensure your files are stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for easy delivery. With these steps, you can deploy your own sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments. This allows you to receive payments directly in crypto, eliminating reliance on traditional payment platforms. Additionally, using a framework like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting ensures that you maintain full control over your digital products and customer data.
Own your entire digital commerce stack with no subscriptions.

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
